name: ClickSyncr for Beehiiv – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms & Formidable
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Beehiiv connects your forms to Beehiiv, so every form submission becomes a subscriber in your Beehiiv publication: automatically, with no code.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one Beehiiv connection. ClickSyncr configures each form right inside the builder you already use, and it connects your forms to 20+ other email marketing platforms too.

“beehiiv” is a trademark of beehiiv Inc. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by beehiiv Inc.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your Beehiiv API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your publications load automatically: choose which Beehiiv publication new subscribers join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map any field: send names, phone numbers, and Beehiiv custom fields straight from your form.
  • Built-in opt-in: add a consent checkbox and ClickSyncr adds Beehiiv subscribers directly when they tick it, or sends a Beehiiv confirmation email when they don’t.
  • Subscriber status control: add directly, send a confirmation email, or defer to your Beehiiv publication’s double opt-in setting, per form.
  • No duplicate subscribers: existing Beehiiv subscribers are reactivated and new ones are added, every single time.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different Beehiiv publication with its own field mapping, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every form’s Beehiiv sync counts and the last error, if any.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent to Beehiiv, and to which publication.

Learn more about the forms to Beehiiv integration.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A Beehiiv account with an API key

Getting your Beehiiv API key

  1. Log in to your Beehiiv account.
  2. Go to Settings > Integrations (or open Beehiiv → Settings → Integrations).
  3. Create a new API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Beehiiv settings of any form.

Support

Need a hand? Browse the documentation, check the frequently asked questions, or contact us and we’ll be glad to help.

Beehiiv

Connected forms send their submissions to Beehiiv. Read more at Beehiiv.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Beehiiv”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr Beehiiv settings.
  2. Paste your Beehiiv API key, choose a publication, and map your fields (email is required).
  3. Save. Every submission now syncs to Beehiiv automatically. Full guidance lives on the ClickSyncr for Beehiiv page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Beehiiv account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Beehiiv account and an API key to sync your subscribers.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Beehiiv API key?

Log in to Beehiiv and go to Settings > Integrations, then create a new API key. Each builder setup guide shows exactly where to paste it.

Can I map custom fields?

Yes. Map any form field to your publication’s Beehiiv custom fields. Fields are per publication, so the mapping list follows the publication you choose.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. When a visitor ticks it, the subscriber is added directly; if they leave it unticked, Beehiiv sends them a confirmation email instead. Leave it as “None” to use the subscriber status you chose for the form.

Does it work with Beehiiv double opt-in?

Yes. Choose “Use publication setting” as the subscriber status and your publication’s own double opt-in setting decides. The Active and Unconfirmed choices override it per form.

Will it create duplicate subscribers?

No. Beehiiv deduplicates by email: existing subscribers are reactivated and new ones are added.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr Beehiiv setup, so each can sync to a different publication.

ClickSyncr for Beehiiv Privacy

The plugin sends only the fields you map, and only to Beehiiv. Nothing is collected by ClickSyncr itself. Read about our policy.
